title: Integrate Langfuse LLM Metrics with Mixpanel for Better Insights
summary: 📊 Connect Your Langfuse LLM Metrics to Mixpanel | @here Building an AI product or feature? Now you can easily see how your LLM outputs tie to user-level outcomes. We've partnered to integrate LLM observability data from Langfuse — such as cost, latency, accuracy, and model version — with product analytics data in Mixpanel. Now you can answer questions like: • 🙋 “Are my most active users also the ones who are most engaged with my LLM content?” • 📈 “Does interacting with the LLM feature relate to higher retention rates?” • 🤔 “How does the LLM feature impact my conversion rates?”* Add your Langfuse data to Mixpanel in seconds: 👉 https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/tracking-methods/integrations/langfuse
